summary.zh-CN: 把受众问题变成有出处、可验证的选题；未知搜索量保持未知。
summary.en: Turn audience problems into sourced opportunities without invented search volume.

inputs.zh-CN: 受众问题、已有页面、搜索观察或用户反馈
inputs.en: Audience problems, existing pages, search observations or feedback

outputs.zh-CN: 机会卡 JSON；推荐下一验证动作
outputs.en: Opportunity cards and a next validation step

safety.zh-CN: 默认只读与本地产物；不自动修改生产、提交索引或外发。
safety.en: Read-only analysis and local artifacts by default; no automatic production changes, indexing submission or outreach.

prompt.zh-CN: 请使用 $seo-opportunity-evidence，仅分析我提供或已授权读取的资料。先检查必要输入，未知数据保留未知，按 Skill 模板交付并列出验收结果；不要自动发布。
prompt.en: Use $seo-opportunity-evidence to analyze only supplied or authorized materials. Check required inputs, preserve unknowns, deliver the skill template and acceptance results, and do not publish automatically.
